verdict.rationale: The repo ships an AGENTS.md, an agent-oriented doc that lists the CLI commands (add, list, update, init, experimental_sync, lock-file restore). The Agent Skills spec is also served as raw markdown at agentskills.io/specification.md, so an agent can be pointed at both. However, no llms.txt is evidenced, and the docs-md probe returned 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a working markdown docs endpoint for skills.sh itself, and hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
